title: Balancing Time Between Friend Groups
paragraphs: After marrying, Layla found herself struggling to balance time between her husband's family, her own close friends, and a new circle of friends she was building through her husband's social circle.
For the first few months, she felt guilty no matter which group she prioritized, worried that spending time with one meant unfairly neglecting the others who also wanted her attention.

Her husband suggested being honest with everyone about her limited time rather than trying to please every group equally, an approach that surprisingly reduced most of the tension she had been feeling.
A year later, Layla had settled into a rhythm that felt sustainable, realizing that clear, honest communication mattered more than perfectly equal time divided among every relationship in her life.
